description.value: Ba Le Deli & Bakery is a family-owned Vietnamese deli and bakery that has been crafting bánh mì sandwiches since 1987, with the Victoria outpost at 774 Fort Street. Baguettes are baked fresh in-house daily, and the menu extends beyond sandwiches to vermicelli bowls and Vietnamese appetizers. It is part of a small multi-location chain with roots in Vancouver, making it a reliable and affordable quick-stop for touring cyclists seeking a filling Vietnamese meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Victoria location of the Ba Le Deli & Bakery chain, with address 774 Fort St, Victoria, BC and phone (778) 440-2646 both matching OSM. The menu includes vermicelli bowls (lemongrass chicken, beef, pork, tofu) and a fried egg sandwich — all cooked dishes — supporting hot food as true. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Bale Banh Mi Sandwiches' but the business consistently presents itself as 'Ba Le Deli & Bakery' or 'Ba Le Banh Mi' across all website pages.
Website is Vancouver-centric ('Over 30 Years in Vancouver') but the Victoria location at 774 Fort St is confirmed on the contact page.
OSM category shop=deli mapped to Groceries; the business is a food-service deli/sandwich shop, not a grocery retailer.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible deli and sandwich shop confirmed by website contact page listing the Victoria location. A practical food stop for touring cyclists.
